lesson.title: 知识要点与三角形综合问答

en.title: Key Ideas At a Glance and Questions

source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition

concepts.title: 三角形：选公式与判多解
concepts.summary: 边与其对角对应，先判断资料类型。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 直角三角形用 $a^2+b^2=c^2$ 和六个三角比。一般三角形：$A+B+C=180^\circ$，$a/\sin A=b/\sin B=c/\sin C$，$c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$。SSA 用反正弦后还须检查补角是否使角和小于 $180^\circ$。面积 $K=ab\sin C/2=\sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}$，$s=(a+b+c)/2$。

pitfalls: 外角不是三角形内角；边长须正，三边须满足严格三角不等式。

en.title: Triangles: formulas and ambiguity
en.summary: Match sides with opposite angles and classify the given data.

method.title: Method
method.body: For a right triangle use $a^2+b^2=c^2$ and the six ratios. In any triangle, $A+B+C=180^\circ$, $a/\sin A=b/\sin B=c/\sin C$, and $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$. For SSA, also test the supplementary inverse-sine angle against the angle sum. Area: $K=ab\sin C/2=\sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}$, $s=(a+b+c)/2$.

pitfalls: An exterior angle is not an interior angle. Side lengths must be positive and satisfy strict triangle inequalities.

concepts.title: 向量、点积、投影与功
concepts.summary: 分量分别相加，长度与方向另算。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\langle x_Q-x_P,y_Q-y_P\rangle$，$\|v\|=\sqrt{v_x^2+v_y^2}$，方向为 $\langle r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta\rangle$。$v\cdot w=v_xw_x+v_yw_y=\|v\|\|w\|\cos\theta$；非零向量的夹角在 $[0,\pi]$。$\operatorname{proj}_w v=(v\cdot w)w/\|w\|^2$，要求 $w\ne0$。功 $W=F\cdot d$。

en.title: Vectors, dot products, projections, and work
en.summary: Add components separately; calculate magnitude and direction afterward.

method.title: Method
method.body: $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\langle x_Q-x_P,y_Q-y_P\rangle$, $\|v\|=\sqrt{v_x^2+v_y^2}$, and a vector of magnitude $r$ and direction $\theta$ is $\langle r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta\rangle$. $v\cdot w=v_xw_x+v_yw_y=\|v\|\|w\|\cos\theta$; the angle between nonzero vectors lies in $[0,\pi]$. $\operatorname{proj}_w v=(v\cdot w)w/\|w\|^2$ requires $w\ne0$. Work is $W=F\cdot d$.

concepts.title: 极坐标与直角坐标
concepts.summary: 负半径沿指定射线的反方向取点。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta,r^2=x^2+y^2$。若指定 $r>0$，取 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$，角按象限选到指定区间。极坐标可用负半径；方程转换须核对原点、除数与平方引入的分支。

en.title: Polar and rectangular coordinates
en.summary: A negative radius locates a point opposite the specified ray.

method.title: Method
method.body: $x=r\cos\theta$, $y=r\sin\theta$, $r^2=x^2+y^2$. When $r>0$ is required, take $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ and select the angle by quadrant in the requested interval. Polar coordinates allow negative radii; equation conversions must check the pole, divisors, and branches introduced by squaring.

concepts.title: 复数极形式与全部复根
concepts.summary: 模相乘除，辐角相加减；根须枚举不同辐角。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)$，$r\ge0$。DeMoivre 定理：$z^n=r^n(\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta)$；负整数次幂须 $z\ne0$。非零 $z$ 的 $n$ 次根为 $r^{1/n}[\cos((\theta+360^\circ k)/n)+i\sin((\theta+360^\circ k)/n)]$，$k=0,\ldots,n-1$。

en.title: Polar complex numbers and all roots
en.summary: Multiply or divide moduli and add or subtract arguments; enumerate distinct root arguments.

method.title: Method
method.body: $z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)$, $r\ge0$. DeMoivre: $z^n=r^n(\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta)$; negative integer powers require $z\ne0$. The $n$th roots of nonzero $z$ are $r^{1/n}[\cos((\theta+360^\circ k)/n)+i\sin((\theta+360^\circ k)/n)]$, $k=0,\ldots,n-1$.

concepts.title: 前章知识的综合运用
concepts.summary: 变换图像、对数和恒等式都保留原定义域。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 函数复合、商与反函数分别处理定义域。对数真数须正。恒等式证明从一边推到另一边，不扩大约分前的定义域。画图标明关键点、周期与渐近线。

en.title: Connections to earlier chapters
en.summary: Retain original domains in transformations, logarithms, and identities.

method.title: Method
method.body: Treat domains separately for composition, quotients, and inverse functions. Logarithm arguments must be positive. Prove identities by transforming one side and retain the domain before cancellation. Graphs need key points, periods, and asymptotes.

exercises.prompt: K1. 判断图中三角形的资料类型并解三角形，答案取十分位。原图给出 $A=39^\circ，c=30$，B点外角 $63^\circ$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 图中B点外角为 $63^\circ$，所以内角 $B=180^\circ-63^\circ=117^\circ$。资料为 ASA。

en.prompt: K1. Classify and solve the triangle shown, to the nearest tenth. Given $A=39^\circ, c=30$ and exterior angle $63^\circ$ at B.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The exterior angle at B is $63^\circ$, hence the interior angle $B=180^\circ-63^\circ=117^\circ$. The data are ASA.

exercises.prompt: K2. 判断图中三角形的资料类型并解三角形，答案取十分位。原图给出 $a=53，c=20$，B点外角 $41^\circ$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 图中B点外角为 $41^\circ$，所以内角 $B=180^\circ-41^\circ=139^\circ$。资料为 SAS。

en.prompt: K2. Classify and solve the triangle shown, to the nearest tenth. Given $a=53, c=20$ and exterior angle $41^\circ$ at B.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The exterior angle at B is $41^\circ$, hence the interior angle $B=180^\circ-41^\circ=139^\circ$. The data are SAS.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 图中B点外角为 $58^\circ$，所以内角 $B=180^\circ-58^\circ=122^\circ$。资料为 AAS。

en.prompt: K3. Classify and solve the triangle shown, to the nearest tenth. Given $A=34^\circ, b=72$ and exterior angle $58^\circ$ at B.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The exterior angle at B is $58^\circ$, hence the interior angle $B=180^\circ-58^\circ=122^\circ$. The data are AAS.

exercises.prompt: K4. 判断图中三角形的资料类型并解三角形，答案取十分位。原图给出 $A=49^\circ，a=45，b=53$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 给定资料类型为 SSA；检验是否存在两解。

en.prompt: K4. Classify and solve the triangle shown, to the nearest tenth. Given $A=49^\circ, a=45, b=53$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The data are SSA; check whether two solutions exist.

exercises.prompt: K5. 判断图中三角形的资料类型并解三角形，答案取十分位。原图给出 $a=55，b=39，c=60$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 已知三边，为SSS。最短两边之和39+55>60，严格三角不等式成立，唯一确定一个三角形。

en.prompt: K5. Classify and solve the triangle shown, to the nearest tenth. Given $a=55, b=39, c=60$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The data are SSS. The two shorter sides satisfy39+55>60, so the strict triangle inequalities hold and determine a unique triangle.
